meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Signal 消息渠道，实现原生收发。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里直接收发 Signal 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Signal channel for native messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send and receive Signal messages in your app.

howto.what: Claude 会把 Signal 接成一个原生频道：经 signal-cli 以「关联设备」方式绑到你现有手机的 Signal 号码，不用新号码、不用机器人 API。之后助手就用这个号码收发消息，支持 Markdown 格式、引用回复和私聊打字状态。
howto.when: 当你想给助手加上 Signal 频道时触发，通常发生在 /setup 流程中，或单独运行本技能添加适配器。需要先用手机上的 Signal 扫描二维码完成关联设备握手。

say.text: 把 Signal 接进来，用我手机上的号码做关联设备。
say.note: 会安装 signal-cli、复制适配器并打印扫码二维码。

say.text: 用 Signal 给我发条测试消息，看看通不通。
say.note: 服务重启后适配器会绑定已关联的账号。

say.text: Signal 改用专用号码注册，不走关联设备。
say.note: 会走验证码加短信或语音验证的注册流程。

howto.what_en: Claude adds a native Signal channel: via signal-cli device-link it binds to the Signal number already on your phone — no new number, no bot API. The assistant then sends and receives as that number.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add Signal to your assistant — usually inside /setup or by running this skill. You first scan a QR from your phone to link the device.

say_en.text: Add Signal and link it as a device on my phone's number.
say_en.note: Installs signal-cli, copies the adapter, prints a QR to scan.

say_en.text: Send me a test message on Signal to check it works.
say_en.note: After restart the adapter binds the linked account.

say_en.text: Register a dedicated number for Signal instead of device-link.
